senses.gloss:
Day,Ⓒs.ⒹdinaM, divasaH, vAsaraH, ahan n., vAraH ‘a lunar d(ay)’ tiTi m. f., ‘d(ay) by d(ay)’ dine dine, anudivasaM, pratyahaM; ‘by d(ay)’ divA; ‘the next d(ay)’ paredyuH, ‘the d(ay) before’ pUrvedyuH; ‘another d(ay)’ anyedyuH; ‘the other d(ay)’ aciraM; ‘d(ay) and night’ aharniSaM, ahorAtraH; rAtriMdivaM, naktaMdivaM; ‘all d(ay) long’ aharniSaM, rAtriMdivaM, divA-niSaM-rAtraM; ‘till this d(ay)’ adya yAvat; ‘the d(ay) after to-morrow’ paraSvaH; ‘he gained the d(ay)’ tasmin dine sa viyajI baBUva; ‘d(ay) break’ See Dawn; ‘d(ay) labour’ vrAtaM, dEnikaM karma; ‘d(ay) labourer’ vrAtInaH; ‘d(ay) light’ sUryaprakASaH, dinajyotis n.; ‘d(ay) star’ praBAtanakzatraM; ‘d(ay) time’ dinakAlaH, dinasamayaH; ‘being in the d(ay)’ divAtana (nI f.); ‘during d(ay)’ divA.
ⓃDaily,Ⓒa.ⒹdEnika-pratyahika-Ahnika (kI f.), dEnaMdina (nI f.) ‘d(aily) business’ AhrikaM, nityakarman n.
Ⓔadv.Ⓓprati in comp. with ‘day’; pratyahaM, pratidinaM; dine dine, aharahaH, &c.
